height.$description: dimension used by the select component for height.

min-target.$description: dimension used by the select component for min target.

padding-inline.$description: dimension used by the select component for padding inline.

gap.$description: dimension used by the select component for gap.

radius.$description: dimension used by the select component for radius (MarsUI Radius/component/radius_md 10px; component ramp so personality modes reach it).

font-size.$description: dimension used by the select component for font size.

font-weight.$description: font weight used by the select component for the trigger value (MarsUI UI/Body 1/medium: weight 600).

line-height.$description: dimension used by the select component for the trigger value line height (MarsUI body_1 24px).

indicator-size.$description: dimension used by the select component for indicator size.

indicator-glyph-size.$description: dimension used by the select component for the chevron glyph box inside the 18px indicator slot (MarsUI Dropdown chevron 8px border-box square drawn by [part=indicator]::before).

border-width.$description: dimension used by the select component for border width (MarsUI Input_cell strokeWeight 1px; the color stays ki.outline.control per the declared a11y deviation — only the 2px width was undocumented).

border-block-start-width.$description: dimension used by the select component for border block start width.

border-block-end-width.$description: dimension used by the select component for border block end width.

border-inline-start-width.$description: dimension used by the select component for border inline start width.

border-inline-end-width.$description: dimension used by the select component for border inline end width.

label-gap.$description: dimension used by the select component for label gap.

label-padding-inline.$description: dimension used by the select component for label padding inline (MarsUI Input_label row 2px inset aligning the label ink with the cell radius; matches ki-input/ki-textarea).

label-font-size.$description: dimension used by the select component for label font size (MarsUI UI/Para/medium: body_1 13px).

label-font-weight.$description: font weight used by the select component for label font weight.

label-line-height.$description: dimension used by the select component for label line height (MarsUI line_height/para 20px).

bg.$description: color used by the select component for rest background (MarsUI Dropdown rest fill Surface/Special/light-s0_dark-s2: white light, Dark/800 dark).

fg.$description: color used by the select component for rest foreground.

border.$description: color used by the select component for rest border.

label-fg.$description: color used by the select component for rest label foreground.

bg.$description: color used by the select component for hover background (MarsUI hover = rest fill + hover_overlay_inverse; nearest cross-scheme step that keeps the ramp monotonic in dark).

fg.$description: color used by the select component for hover foreground.

border.$description: color used by the select component for hover border. Brief §1: hover moves along the neutral outline em ramp (Black/12), matching ki-input/ki-textarea; the primary accent outline is the focus language (Focus/primary), not hover.

label-fg.$description: color used by the select component for hover label foreground.

bg.$description: color used by the select component for focus background (MarsUI Dropdown focus fill Surface/Special/light-s0_dark-s4).

fg.$description: color used by the select component for focus foreground.

border.$description: color used by the select component for focus border (MarsUI active is glow-only: the border stays the rest hairline while Focus/primary carries the emphasis — repointed from ki.outline.primary-high-em per the fidelity audit; material3 keeps the opaque primary border via its override).

label-fg.$description: color used by the select component for focus label foreground.

bg.$description: color used by the select component for disabled background.

fg.$description: color used by the select component for disabled foreground (MarsUI disabled text Text/base_em Gray/400; disabled cells are exempt from the contrast sweep).

border.$description: color used by the select component for disabled border (MarsUI Outline/base_em Black/3).

label-fg.$description: color used by the select component for disabled label foreground.

placeholder-fg.$description: color used by the select component for placeholder foreground.

bg.$description: color used by the select component for listbox background (MarsUI Dropmenu glass panel Surface/Special/blur_base_light White/80; pair with backdrop-filter blur(var(--ki-select-listbox-backdrop-blur))).

backdrop-blur.$description: backdrop blur used by the select component listbox glass panel (MarsUI BACKGROUND_BLUR Blur/48 = CSS 24px; material3 resolves to blur none via its override).

radius.$description: dimension used by the select component for listbox radius (MarsUI Radius/big_component/radius_sm 20px bound on the Dropmenu panel).

elevation.$description: color used by the select component for listbox elevation. Legacy of the pre-ramp hand-composed listbox shadow, superseded by ki.select.listbox.shadow; kept published because the public-api contract requires deprecation metadata at least one minor before removal.

shadow.$description: shadow used by the select component for the listbox: MarsUI elevation ramp e3 (brief §5), the medium floating-surface level, replacing the former hand-composed offset/color shadow. Declared level: e3 (M3 analog: menu/dialog band; material3 overrides to e2 = md.sys.elevation.level2 for menus).

padding.$description: dimension used by the select component for listbox padding (MarsUI Dropmenu content inset Space/xl 12px).

max-block-size.$description: dimension used by the select component for listbox max block size (surface size scale; the former ki.space.25xl reference misused the spacing scale).

offset.$description: dimension used by the select component for listbox offset.

color.$description: color used by the select component for focus ring color.

width.$description: dimension used by the select component for focus ring width.

offset.$description: dimension used by the select component for focus ring offset.

shadow.$description: shadow used by the select component for the focus ring glow (MarsUI Focus/primary: 3px spread ring at 20% — see ki.focus.primary. specs/002-ki-button/design-extraction.md §2.5 recorded 40%, having read the alpha off the Dark canvas mode, same double mechanism as ki-button: glow plus the opaque indicator).
